title: EqualCostHops stale-table guard has no direct test
detail: The r1 defensive fix is untested: build table, add a node (gen bump), call EqualCostHops, assert false (no route) rather than OOB. PARTIAL coverage of a bounds-critical path.
recommended_fix: Add a stale-table case to the routing test block on both runners.

title: StateHash growth loop untested — no test produces a state exceeding the initial 4096-byte capacity
detail: The doubling path (the actual fix for the silent-false-green) never executes in any test; the PIE state (10k demand entries ≈ 220KB) is never hashed by a test. NONE for the growth branch.
recommended_fix: Add a test seeding ~300 demand entries (or pipes) so serialization exceeds 4096 and assert the hash equals a small-buffer-independent value / changes deterministically.

title: FlowStep no-route wait branch (WaitingTicks += 1) untested
detail: Every scenario/test draws pipes before demand spawns, so the wait-then-retry path (the E29-adjacent resilience path) never runs; the only WaitingTicks assertion checks it stays 0 after severance.
recommended_fix: Add a case: demand spawns before any draw; assert packet waits (WaitingTicks grows), then draws land and it delivers.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: Core behaviors have dual-runner coverage: topology rules, span metric, ECMP stability/spread, bundle sums, flow deliver/E29/recovery/contention, ApplyEdit live-vs-replay convergence, serialization byte-pin, golden.
